decisions.reason: As a large, established German optics/electronics firm, we would likely retain a newly launched space camera with its own dedicated page because early aerospace products face long qualification and sales cycles and current evidence does not show performance clearly below aspiration.

The modular space navigation camera appears strategically related to the firm's capabilities, and with organisational slack and only one year of market exposure we would continue it while learning unless stronger signs of underperformance emerge.

A space situational awareness sensor suite fits a specialized growth niche, so under behavioral logic we would keep it for now because uncertainty is still high and a large incumbent can tolerate some short-run ambiguity around results.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is more at risk because it had weaker website prominence, but given the firm's size, the strategic fit with advanced optical sensing, and the long development horizon in space markets, we would still give it more time rather than drop it immediately.
